title: Misconception Poll With Teaching Notes
whatYouGet: A short concept-check poll whose distractors diagnose specific misconceptions and whose teacher notes prescribe the next explanation.
howToUse: Name one concept and known misconceptions, audit the diagnostic mapping, run the Form script, and teach from the response split.
effectiveUsage: 1. Choose one concept that can be checked in three to five focused questions.
2. Replace generic distractors with mistakes you have actually seen in class.
3. Run the script and preview every option on a phone before sharing.
4. Use the teaching note linked to the most-selected wrong option for an immediate mini-lesson.
commonFix: If wrong, reply with: "Replace random distractors with options produced by named misconceptions, then explain the evidence each choice gives the teacher."
promptText:
ROLE: Act as a formative-assessment specialist, misconception analyst and Google Forms poll developer.

CONTEXT: A teacher needs a rapid concept check for [CLASS] on [CONCEPT], with useful action attached to every response pattern.

INPUTS — FILL EVERY PLACEHOLDER:
- [CLASS]
- [CONCEPT]
- [QUESTION COUNT, DEFAULT 4]
- [KNOWN MISCONCEPTIONS]
- [LESSON OBJECTIVE]
- [POLL TIME]

DO THIS:

2. Give a teacher-only mapping from every option to the likely reasoning behind it.
3. Add one quick re-teach move and one follow-up question for each misconception.
4. Verify every computational key with a check-this-yourself link and separate mathematical correctness from diagnostic interpretation.
5. Generate one complete executable FormApp script with quiz mode, correct choices, points, feedback and logged URLs.
6. Finish with a response-split decision table for what to teach next.

WORKED LINK EXAMPLE — COPY THIS EXACT ENCODING PATTERN:
Example task: Poll Class 7 students on solving 3x+4=19.
Expected result or check target: The verified solution is x=5; options 23/3, 15 and 5/3 are each tied to a different inverse-operation mistake.
check this yourself
CHECK → https://www.wolframalpha.com/input?i=solve%203x%2B4%3D19
(paste-fallback: solve 3x+4=19)
Encoding note: The space is %20, + is %2B and = is %3D.

OUTPUT FORMAT:
1. CONCEPT POLL REVIEW
2. OPTION-TO-MISCONCEPTION MAP
3. TEACH-NEXT NOTES
4. COMPLETE GOOGLE APPS SCRIPT
5. RUN IT — script.google.com → New project → paste → Run → View → Logs
6. RESPONSE-SPLIT DECISION TABLE

QUALITY AND TOOL GUARDRAILS:
- Output one COMPLETE executable FormApp code block; no TODOs or manual question-entry gaps.
- After the code, print exactly: script.google.com → New project → paste → Run → View → Logs.
- Every distractor must correspond to a stated misconception rather than being random filler.
- Label solver links check this yourself and keep student-facing feedback respectful.

title: Textbook Photo to Phone Quiz
whatYouGet: A faithful transcription audit, checked phone quiz, complete Google Forms script and Wayground paste block made from an attached textbook page.
howToUse: Attach one clear page photo, state the class and quiz length, confirm the transcription, then run or import the format you need.
effectiveUsage: 1. Attach a sharp, straight photo with every symbol, option and diagram label visible.

4. Give a review key with short solutions and check-this-yourself links for each computational result.
5. Generate one complete executable FormApp script with quiz mode, correct choices, points and logged URLs.
6. Also provide a plain-ASCII Wayground paste block under 10,000 characters with the same key.
7. Finish with a source-to-quiz trace table so the teacher can spot transcription drift.
